people.name: Ginath
people.line: Father of Tibni, who opposed Omri for kingship.

people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

people.name: Omri
people.line: King of Israel; father of Ahab

people.name: Tibni
people.line: Rival to Omri for the throne of Israel

translations.web: Then the people of Israel were divided into two parts: half of the people followed Tibni the son of Ginath, to make him king; and half followed Omri.
translations.bsb: At that time the people of Israel were divided: Half of the people supported Tibni son of Ginath as king, and half supported Omri.
translations.kjv: Then were the people of Israel divided into two parts: half of the people followed Tibni the son of Ginath, to make him king; and half followed Omri.
